items.title: Own The Means of Cognition
items.excerpt: Own the means of cognition and you don't need a ministry of truth, the modal in everyone's pocket does the job.

items.title: Whats the frequency, Kenneth?
items.excerpt: Cold war style number stations for good little bots built on Ethereum

items.title: On Diffusion
items.excerpt: From early StyleGAN experiments and latent walks to Mercury 2's fast diffusion language model, and a simulation stripped down until its agents begin coining terms of their own.

items.title: Text your tools
items.excerpt: Wiring a Farfield homelab up to iMessage with Photon and OpenPoke, so slash commands reach personal apps and talking to your agent feels like texting a friend instead of learning another tool.

items.title: Now Playing
items.excerpt: Putting my Apple Music "Now Playing" on display with a Raspberry Pi and a 64x64 LED matrix.

items.title: Post-UI
items.excerpt: Do we still need to ship a frontend?

items.title: Intern
items.excerpt: The Autonomous Intern ships as a Raspberry Pi 5 in a desk-toy case running a stack I didn't pick. I flashed it to Debian Trixie, swapped the whole thing for the Hermes agent with its own built-in memory, and folded it all into one setup script.

items.title: Toy GPTs
items.excerpt: Two tiny GPTs out of Karpathy's microGPT. One keeps its weights on Ethereum. The other holds a séance with dead presidents.

items.title: Adventures in Machine Vision
items.excerpt: A Nat Friedman anecdote about an AI watching him drink water sent me digging for a spare Raspberry Pi. Now a camera and a sensor HAT watch my desk, a self-inflicted panopticon that logs who walks by and what the room is doing.

items.title: Farfield
items.excerpt: Five small Go services, single binaries, content-addressed records, running on my homelab. The new backend for the site.

items.title: I Got a Common Turtle
items.excerpt: I got a Common turtle from Claude Code's deterministic buddy system, so I brute-forced the generation algorithm.

items.title: Replacing a Rabbit's Brain: Connecting the R1 to Hermes
items.excerpt: I replaced the OpenClaw agent on my R1 with Hermes, running locally on a MacBook Pro.
